ambient_events: The infinity edge sheets over in a thin, endless film, whispering as it goes.
The fire-trough gutters and steadies against the rooftop wind.
description: The roof terrace on the north side of the lantern, open to a sky the colour of cold pewter. A lap pool runs the length of the north parapet behind a glass rail, its edge spilling into the drop so the water seems to pour off the roof and into the city itself. Teak loungers, a low fire-trough, and a glass pavilion on the east corner with a marble bar in it. The wind up here is clean and constant, and the whole of Coldwater is spread out beneath you like something you might, one day, afford. The lantern is south.
name: Solenne Sky Deck
